text:
The plate looks like a side plate of about 20 cm. On it is one slice of toasted bread or bruschetta, roughly 10×13 cm, topped with arugula, tomato and a soft cheese such as burrata or mozzarella. I estimate about 50 g of bread, 20 g of cheese, 15 g of tomato, 5 g of arugula and some oil, for roughly 95 g in total. That works out to about 130 kcal from the bread, 50 from the cheese, 5 from the tomato and 40 from the oil, or about 225 kcal.
